name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a chance encounter at a local karting event. Initially a software engineer, he quickly recognized the potential of data analytics to revolutionize racing strategies. He transitioned his skills, dedicating himself to mastering the intricacies of telemetry and simulation. 

At Alpine F1, Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach and ability to distill complex data sets into actionable insights. He emphasizes collaboration, working closely with engineers and strategists to optimize performance. His calm demeanor and pragmatic solutions have made him a respected figure within the team, particularly valued during high-pressure race weekends.

Ricardo's distinctive edge lies in his holistic understanding of motorsport – he's not just crunching numbers but visualizing the real-world implications on the track. This allows him to anticipate potential problems and proactively suggest innovative solutions before they impact performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-written calculations.
Insists on drinking chamomile tea before every race debrief.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
